name: snapper-mcp-local
description: Local-build Snapper MCP bridge pointing at localhost:8000. Uses the in-repo dist (integrations/snapper-mcp/dist/index.js) so changes to bridge source apply after `npm run build`. Reads credentials from the plugin's own ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/env.json, the same mechanism the published plugin uses — __SNAPPER_REPO_ROOT__ stays only for the in-repo dist path, which no host variable can supply. Rendered by `make local-plugin` — do not edit the rendered copy in data/.

monitors.name: snapper-watch-local
monitors.description: Live LOCALHOST Snapper signal + order events streamed as JSONL
